title: BATAYAN: A Filipino NLP benchmark for evaluating Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Benchmarking LLMs on a holistic suite of natively-sourced and authentically translated Filipino NLP tasks (understanding, reasoning, and generation) to measure performance disparities between general multilingual models and models with explicit Filipino instruction tuning, highlighting the under-representation of the language in pre-training data.

Analyzing and filtering existing translated Filipino corpora using native-speaker acceptability judgments to identify and mitigate unnatural phrasing, disfluency, and forced grammatical structures (such as unnatural 'ay-inversions') that stem from the influence of the source language (English).
